claims.claim_ar: النداء بـ «يا أيها الذين آمنوا» تحويل الخطاب إلى مخاطَب مخصوص (التنبيه والاختصاص) — أي لفت الانتباه للمؤمنين.
claims.claim_en: The vocative 'يا أيها الذين آمنوا' effects an iltifat (shift) by addressing a specific group (the believers), directing and focusing the injunction.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting excerpt in the sources uses the phrase «هم المؤمنون» (commentary identification of the addressee) rather than the exact Qur'anic vocative; the claim links that commentary to the ayah's vocative.

claims.claim_ar: أداة الاستثناء «إِلَّا» تقيّد النهي العام وتستثني حالة معينة (التجارة عن تراضٍ) — أي قصر المنع بذكر استثناء مفصّل.
claims.claim_en: The exception marker 'إِلَّا' restricts the general prohibition, exempting the specific case of mutually consenting trade; it is a hasr/qasr (restriction/exception) device.
claims.needs_review_reason: Source commentary explicitly treats «التجارة» as the exempted case, giving direct support; the exact ayah phrasing is not quoted verbatim in the chunk but the commentator's gloss names the exception.

claims.claim_ar: التوازي في النهيين («لَا تَأْكُلُوا…» و«وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا…») يؤدي وظيفة موازنـة/مقابلة بين محظورين مختلفين، وهو أسلوبِ مقاربة/مقابلة بلاغي يوضّح شمول الحظر.
claims.claim_en: The paired prohibitions ('Do not consume...' and 'Do not kill...') form a parallel/antithetical structure (muqābalah), balancing two distinct but morally related prohibitions to emphasize their seriousness.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting excerpt shows a parallel adjectival structure from commentary on another passage; the claim generalizes this rhetorical parallelism to the present ayah — the source quote is analogous rather than the exact ayah text.

warnings: Source quotations are taken from the provided tafsir chunks but do not always reproduce the ayah's exact wording; some quotes are commentator paraphrases or analogous examples.

Several claims extrapolate rhetorical features (e.g., parallelism) by analogy using commentator examples from related verses; these should be reviewed against the full tafsir context if precise textual corroboration is required.

Roots/lemmas for particles like «إِلَّا» and vocatives are given for identification, but traditional root morphology may be non-standard for such particles; confirm if a different convention is preferred.
